title: Cats stare at indoor birds like they are plotting the ultimate bird chase
description:
These cats were having a full-on National Geographic moment from the other side of the glass!

Sukinah shared this hilarious clip where her cats, stationed like security guards outside the house, had their eyes laser-locked on the birds freely strutting around inside.

''I let my birds out to roam around the house, and my beautiful cats noticed and immediately wanted to go in and catch them,'' she told WooGlobe.

It was like bird TV for them—live, in full color, and utterly out of reach.
